61:# Standard conversion support for thai_strftime()
62:def _std_strftime(dt_obj: datetime, fmt_char: str) -> str:
63:    """
64:    Standard datetime.strftime() with normalization and exception handling.
65:    """
66:    str_ = ""
67:    try:
68:        str_ = dt_obj.strftime(f"%{fmt_char}")
69:        if not str_ or str_ == f"%{fmt_char}":
70:            # normalize outputs for unsupported directives
71:            # in different platforms
72:            # "%Q" may result "%Q", "Q", or "", make it "Q"
73:            str_ = fmt_char
74:    except ValueError as err:  # pragma: no cover
75:        # Unsupported directives may raise ValueError on Windows,
76:        # in that case just use the fmt_char
77:        warnings.warn(
78:            (f"String format directive unknown/not support: %{fmt_char}" f"The system raises this ValueError: {err}"),
79:            UserWarning,
80:        )
81:        str_ = fmt_char
82:    return str_

85:# Thai conversion support for thai_strftime()
86:def _thai_strftime(
87:    dt_obj: datetime,
88:    fmt_char: str,
89:    buddhist_era: bool = True,
90:) -> str:
91:    """
92:    Conversion support for thai_strftime().
93:
94:    The fmt_char should be in _NEED_L10N when call this function.
95:    """
96:    str_ = ""
97:    year = dt_obj.year
98:    if buddhist_era:
99:        year = year + _BE_AD_DIFFERENCE
100:
101:    if fmt_char == "A":
102:        # National representation of the full weekday name
103:        str_ = _TH_FULL_WEEKDAYS[dt_obj.weekday()]
104:    elif fmt_char == "a":
105:        # National representation of the abbreviated weekday
106:        str_ = _TH_ABBR_WEEKDAYS[dt_obj.weekday()]
107:    elif fmt_char == "B":
108:        # National representation of the full month name
109:        str_ = _TH_FULL_MONTHS[dt_obj.month - 1]
110:    elif fmt_char == "b":
111:        # National representation of the abbreviated month name
112:        str_ = _TH_ABBR_MONTHS[dt_obj.month - 1]
113:    elif fmt_char == "C":
114:        # Thai Buddhist century (AD+543)/100 + 1 as decimal number;
115:        str_ = str(int(year / 100) + 1).zfill(2)
116:    elif fmt_char == "c":
117:        # Locale’s appropriate date and time representation
118:        # Wed  6 Oct 01:40:00 1976
119:        # พ   6 ต.ค. 01:40:00 2519  <-- left-aligned weekday, right-aligned day
120:        str_ = (
121:            f"{_TH_ABBR_WEEKDAYS[dt_obj.weekday()]:<2} {dt_obj.day:>2} "
122:            f"{_TH_ABBR_MONTHS[dt_obj.month - 1]} {dt_obj:%H:%M:%S} {year:04}"
123:        )
124:    elif fmt_char == "D":
125:        # Equivalent to ``%m/%d/%y''
126:        str_ = f"{dt_obj:%m/%d}/{year % 100:02}"
127:    elif fmt_char == "F":
128:        # Equivalent to ``%Y-%m-%d''
129:        str_ = f"{year:04}-{dt_obj:%m-%d}"
130:    elif fmt_char == "G":
131:        # ISO 8601 year with century representing the year that contains
132:        # the greater part of the ISO week (%V). Monday as the first day
133:        # of the week.
134:        year_G = int(dt_obj.strftime("%G"))
135:        if buddhist_era:
136:            year_G = year_G + _BE_AD_DIFFERENCE
137:        str_ = f"{year_G:04}"
138:    elif fmt_char == "g":
139:        # Same year as in ``%G'',
140:        # but as a decimal number without century (00-99).
141:        year_G = int(dt_obj.strftime("%G"))
142:        if buddhist_era:
143:            year_G = year_G + _BE_AD_DIFFERENCE
144:        str_ = f"{year_G % 100:02}"
145:    elif fmt_char == "v":
146:        # BSD extension, ' 6-Oct-1976'
147:        str_ = f"{dt_obj.day:>2}-{_TH_ABBR_MONTHS[dt_obj.month - 1]}-{year:04}"
148:    elif fmt_char == "X":
149:        # Locale’s appropriate time representation.
150:        str_ = f"{dt_obj:%H:%M:%S}"
151:    elif fmt_char == "x":
152:        # Locale’s appropriate date representation.
153:        str_ = f"{dt_obj:%d/%m}/{year:04}"
154:    elif fmt_char == "Y":
155:        # Year with century
156:        str_ = f"{year:04}"
157:    elif fmt_char == "y":
158:        # Year without century
159:        str_ = f"{year % 100:02}"
160:    elif fmt_char == "+":
161:        # National representation of the date and time
162:        # (the format is similar to that produced by date(1))
163:        # Wed  6 Oct 1976 01:40:00
164:        str_ = (
165:            f"{_TH_ABBR_WEEKDAYS[dt_obj.weekday()]:<2} {dt_obj.day:>2} "
166:            f"{_TH_ABBR_MONTHS[dt_obj.month - 1]} {year} {dt_obj:%H:%M:%S}"
167:        )
168:
169:    return str_

172:def thai_strftime(
173:    dt_obj: datetime,
174:    fmt: str = "%-d %b %Y",
175:    thai_digit: bool = False,
176:    buddhist_era: bool = True,
177:) -> str:
178:    """
179:    Convert :class:`datetime.datetime` into Thai date and time format.
180:
181:    The formatting directives are similar to :func:`datatime.strrftime`.
182:
183:    This function uses Thai names and Thai Buddhist Era for these directives:
184:        * **%a** - abbreviated weekday name
185:        (i.e. "จ", "อ", "พ", "พฤ", "ศ", "ส", "อา")
186:        * **%A** - full weekday name
187:        (i.e. "วันจันทร์", "วันอังคาร", "วันเสาร์", "วันอาทิตย์")
188:        * **%b** - abbreviated month name
189:        (i.e. "ม.ค.", "ก.พ.", "มี.ค.", "เม.ย.", "พ.ค.", "มิ.ย.", "ธ.ค.")
190:        * **%B** - full month name
191:        (i.e. "มกราคม", "กุมภาพันธ์", "พฤศจิกายน", "ธันวาคม",)
192:        * **%y** - year without century (i.e. "56", "10")
193:        * **%Y** - year with century (i.e. "2556", "2410")
194:        * **%c** - date and time representation
195:        (i.e. "พ   6 ต.ค. 01:40:00 2519")
196:        * **%v** - short date representation
197:        (i.e. " 6-ม.ค.-2562", "27-ก.พ.-2555")
198:    """
199:    thaidate_parts = []
200:
201:    i = 0
202:    fmt_len = len(fmt)
203:    while i < fmt_len:
204:        str_ = ""
205:        if fmt[i] == "%":
206:            j = i + 1
207:            if j < fmt_len:
208:                fmt_char = fmt[j]
209:                if fmt_char in _NEED_L10N:  # requires localization?
210:                    str_ = _thai_strftime(dt_obj, fmt_char, buddhist_era)
211:                elif fmt_char in _EXTENSIONS:
212:                    fmt_char_ext = fmt_char
213:                    k = j + 1
214:                    if k < fmt_len:
215:                        fmt_char = fmt[k]
216:                        if fmt_char in _NEED_L10N:
217:                            str_ = _thai_strftime(
218:                                dt_obj,
219:                                fmt_char,
220:                                buddhist_era,
221:                            )
222:                        else:
223:                            str_ = _std_strftime(dt_obj, fmt_char)
224:
225:                        if fmt_char_ext == "-":
226:                            # GNU libc extension,
227:                            # no padding
228:                            if str_[0] and str_[0] in " 0":
229:                                str_ = str_[1:]
230:                        elif fmt_char_ext == "_":
231:                            # GNU libc extension,
232:                            # explicitly specify space (" ") for padding
233:                            if str_[0] and str_[0] == "0":
234:                                str_ = " " + str_[1:]
235:                        elif fmt_char_ext == "0":
236:                            # GNU libc extension,
237:                            # explicitly specify zero ("0") for padding
238:                            if str_[0] and str_[0] == " ":
239:                                str_ = "0" + str_[1:]
240:                        elif fmt_char_ext == "^":
241:                            # GNU libc extension,
242:                            # convert to upper case
243:                            str_ = str_.upper()
244:                        elif fmt_char_ext == "#":
245:                            # GNU libc extension,
246:                            # swap case - useful for %Z
247:                            str_ = str_.swapcase()
248:                        elif fmt_char_ext == "E":
249:                            # POSIX extension,
250:                            # uses the locale's alternative representation
251:                            # Not implemented yet
252:                            pass
253:                        elif fmt_char_ext == "O":
254:                            # POSIX extension,
255:                            # uses the locale's alternative numeric symbols
256:                            str_ = str_.translate(_HA_TH_DIGITS)
257:                        i = i + 1  # consume char after format char
258:                    else:
259:                        # format char at string's end has no meaning
260:                        str_ = fmt_char_ext
261:                else:  # not in _NEED_L10N nor _EXTENSIONS
262:                    # no known localization available, use Python's default
263:                    str_ = _std_strftime(dt_obj, fmt_char)
264:
265:                i = i + 1  # consume char after "%"
266:            else:
267:                # % char at string's end has no meaning
268:                str_ = "%"
269:        else:
270:            str_ = fmt[i]
271:
272:        thaidate_parts.append(str_)
273:        i = i + 1
274:
275:    thaidate_text = "".join(thaidate_parts)
276:
277:    if thai_digit:
278:        thaidate_text = thaidate_text.translate(_HA_TH_DIGITS)
279:
280:    return thaidate_text
